simStateSpace

Source: AGENTS.md

This project follows the house rules in your global instructions (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.codex/AGENTS.md, ~/.copilot/copilot-instructions.md). This file adds only what is specific to this project.

Read .setup/ai/project.md first. It holds the project facts that the user maintains (aims, data, notation, co-authors, open issues).

Project

  • Name: simStateSpace
  • Type: package
  • Private repository: jeksterslab-psu/simStateSpace (Overleaf pushes here)
  • Overleaf project: not recorded (.setup/repo/private-overleaf.md)
  • Public repository: jeksterslab/simStateSpace (make auto pushes here)
  • These come from .setup/repo/ (private). O2G checks the private repository; PUB checks the public one.
  • Image: the user chooses it and runs apptainer exec <image> make <target>; R is not installed on the host. Do not pick an image. When a command needs one, ask, or give the command with <image> for the user to fill in. .setup/ai/project.md may note the image the project usually uses.

Folder map

Folder Contents
R/ package functions, one per file
tests/testthat/ tests
.setup/scripts/ project.R (project settings) and the make scripts
.setup/data-raw/ shareable raw data
.setup/data-private/ restricted data: never public
.setup/ai/ specs, the plan, project.md (private)
.setup/logs/ one log per Overleaf push, and index.md (private)
.setup/repo/ where the project lives (private)

Make targets

Target Does
make all build, docs, LaTeX, pkgdown, quarto, coverage
make lint style and lint the R code, and report Overleaf limits
make sizecheck check Overleaf limits; run before uploading
make spec TOPIC=<topic> start a spec for a change set
make log TOPIC=<topic> SUMMARY="..." write the change-set log and its file list (UPDATE=TRUE refreshes the list)
make verify RECORD=TRUE after the user pushes from Overleaf (O2G): verify and record the push. On Roar, run bash .setup/scripts/verify.sh on the host first to pull.
make auto publish to the public repository (checks the export first)

Generated files: never edit by hand

NAMESPACE, man/, README.md, CITATION.cff, LICENSE*, .Rbuildignore, project.Rproj, R/RcppExports.R, src/RcppExports.cpp, */bib.bib, vignettes/*.Rmd built from .setup/vignettes/, .setup/latex/pdf/, .setup/latex/figures/, data/*.rda. Change their sources and run make.

Size

Overleaf’s GitHub sync stops above 7 MB of editable text and caps text files at 2 MB. Keep large data compressed (binary, e.g. .Rds or .xz) and never store the same file twice. make sizecheck reports problems.

Package

  • Every exported function has roxygen documentation and tests.
  • make all runs the checks; fix every error, warning, and note.
  • Keep the R style rules from your global instructions (BigCamelCase, one function per file, internal .Foo functions in R/<pkg>-<name>-dot.R).
